Side quest: unlocked 🐌

@isaacperrins found a snail while on a sunset bike ride and turned it into a timelapse. He propped his phone on his shoe and walked back and forth to show the speed difference.

“Most of the videos I make aren’t planned, they just come from simply enjoying life and being open to whatever happens.”

Video by @isaacperrins

Music by @tvgirl and @jordananye
